import os, json, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
data = pd.read_csv(os.environ['SWARMX_SCIENCE_INPUT_0'])
data['percent'] = 100 * data.germinated / data.total
means = data.groupby('treatment').percent.mean()
assert means['control'] == 79 and means['primed'] == 87
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.4, 4.2), layout='constrained')
ax.bar([0, 1], [means['control'], means['primed']], width=0.52, color=['#9ca3af', '#374151'])
for i, group in enumerate(['control', 'primed']):
    ax.scatter([i-0.08, i, i+0.08], data.loc[data.treatment == group, 'percent'], s=22, color='white', edgecolor='black', zorder=3)
    ax.text(i, means[group]+4, f'{means[group]:.0f}%', ha='center', fontsize=13)
ax.set(xticks=[0, 1], xticklabels=['Control (n = 3)', 'Primed (n = 3)'], ylabel='Germination (%)', ylim=(0, 100), title='Synthetic germination fixture')
ax.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)
fig.supxlabel('Difference: 8 percentage points | Demonstration data only', fontsize=9)
fig.savefig('germination.png', dpi=180)
plt.close(fig)
print(json.dumps({'controlMeanPercent': float(means['control']), 'primedMeanPercent': float(means['primed']), 'differencePercentagePoints': float(means['primed']-means['control']), 'replicatesPerGroup': 3, 'scope': 'synthetic demonstration; no biological inference'}))

import csv
import hashlib
import json

prefix = b'SWARMX_SCIENCE_INPUT_0='
with open('/proc/self/environ', 'rb') as handle:
    input_paths = [entry[len(prefix):].decode('utf-8') for entry in handle.read().split(b'\0') if entry.startswith(prefix)]
assert len(input_paths) == 1, 'Expected exactly one SWARMX_SCIENCE_INPUT_0 path'
with open(input_paths[0], 'rb') as handle:
    original_bytes = handle.read()
input_digest = 'sha256:' + hashlib.sha256(original_bytes).hexdigest()
reader = csv.DictReader(original_bytes.decode('utf-8-sig').splitlines(keepends=True))
assert reader.fieldnames, 'Expected a CSV header'
assert len(set(reader.fieldnames)) == len(reader.fieldnames), 'CSV headers must be unique'
columns = {}
for role, accepted_names in {
    'group': ('group', 'treatment', 'condition'),
    'germinated': ('germinated', 'germinated_seeds', 'seeds_germinated', 'germinated_count'),
    'total': ('total', 'total_seeds', 'seeds_total', 'seeds_sown', 'sown', 'total_count'),
}.items():
    matches = [name for name in reader.fieldnames if name.strip().lower().replace(' ', '_') in accepted_names]
    assert len(matches) == 1, 'Expected one unambiguous CSV column for ' + role
    columns[role] = matches[0]

percentages = {'control': [], 'primed': []}
row_percentages = []
for row_number, row in enumerate(reader, start=1):
    assert None not in row and all(value is not None for value in row.values()), 'CSV row width must match header'
    group = row[columns['group']].strip().lower()
    assert group in percentages, 'Expected control or primed group'
    germinated = int(row[columns['germinated']])
    total = int(row[columns['total']])
    assert total > 0 and 0 <= germinated <= total, 'Invalid germination counts'
    percent = 100 * germinated / total
    percentages[group].append(percent)
    row_percentages.append({'row': row_number, 'group': group, 'germination_percent': percent})
assert all(percentages.values()), 'Both groups must contain rows'
counts = {group: len(values) for group, values in percentages.items()}
means = {group: sum(values) / len(values) for group, values in percentages.items()}
difference = means['primed'] - means['control']
expected_digest = 'sha256:7c22c618bbd87c92777e76625a8e2225b10d30adfe4823ffdb986bd2bfd63838'
comparisons = {
    'control_mean_equals_79_percent': means['control'] == 79,
    'primed_mean_equals_87_percent': means['primed'] == 87,
    'primed_minus_control_equals_8_percentage_points': difference == 8,
    'control_count_equals_3': counts['control'] == 3,
    'primed_count_equals_3': counts['primed'] == 3,
    'input_digest_matches_expected': input_digest == expected_digest,
}
print(json.dumps({
    'row_germination_percentages': row_percentages,
    'arithmetic_group_means_percent': means,
    'primed_minus_control_percentage_points': difference,
    'counts_per_group': counts,
    'input_digest': input_digest,
    'expected_input_digest': expected_digest,
    'comparisons': comparisons,
    'scope': 'synthetic demonstration; no biological inference',
}, indent=2), flush=True)
for comparison, matches in comparisons.items():
    assert matches, comparison + ' failed'
